provenance.text: AI-assisted original classroom writing, reviewed for child-friendly A2/B1 readability; dictionary sources are recorded in word_study.
provenance.images: No image asset in v1; the teaching page intentionally leaves the image area empty.

teaching.example: These pictures are important for the story.
teaching.example_zh: 这些图片对这个故事很重要。

extra_examples.en: It is important to listen carefully.

teaching.student_prompt: 说出今天最 important 的一件事。
teaching.cloze: These pictures are __________ for the story.
teaching.cloze_zh: 这些图片对这个故事很重要。
teaching.note: 把 important 作为完整单词记住，再联系名词 importance。

word_study.explanation_zh: 不要按字母硬拆；先整体记住，再和名词 importance 建立联系。

family.connection_zh: important 的相关名词是 importance。

example.en: We understand the importance of water.

challenge.prompt_zh: important 是形容词；它的相关名词是什么？
